_description: Turns that run until they are cancelled. The default streams a little, then sleeps 30 s (cancellable at any moment; session/cancel ends the turn with stopReason 'cancelled'). A prompt containing 'permission' first asks for a Bash permission and leaves it pending, so cancelling must answer it with the Cancelled outcome.
